Shanghai Municipal Police.

CENTRAL Station.
June 12 1922

REPORT ON Activities of the Bolshevist Agent Lepehin

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence

Sir,

Further inquiries go to show that Lepehin has now assumed the false name of Nikoleff. It is stated that Lepehin recently received a telegram from Bluhar, Chief of the "Red" Troops in the Far Eastern Republic, instructing him to recruit technical men, especially qualified naval officers, who are urgently needed. The telegram also instructed Lepehin to send the recruited men with documents establishing their identity to Paikes, the representative of the Far Eastern Republic in Peking, and adds that Paikes has been instructed to send them to Chita.

Lepehin was seen in the Jewish Club on June 11.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. I. Givens
D. C. I.

（印：4361 22 / 3 / 6）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

中央巡捕房。
1922年6月12日

关于布尔什维克代理人列佩欣（Lepehin）活动情况的报告

由 D. I. Givens 撰写，经刑事情报处处长转呈

先生：

进一步调查显示，列佩欣现已使用尼科莱夫（Nikoleff）这一假名。据称，列佩欣最近收到远东共和国“红军”部队首领布鲁哈尔（Bluhar）发来的电报，指示他招募技术人员，特别是具备资质的海军军官，此类人员目前急需。该电报还指示列佩欣将招募到的人员连同确立其身份的文件一并送往北京，交给远东共和国代表派克斯（Paikes），并补充说已指示派克斯将这些人员送往赤塔。

6月11日，有人在犹太俱乐部见到列佩欣。

此致，
敬礼
D. I. Givens
刑事情报处副主任

（印：4361 22 / 3 / 6）

4581
FROM THE POLICE FORCE,
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL,
To D.I. Sullivan. 13/6/22.
Hongkow STATION.
Shanghai, 30. 5. 1922

Sir,

I received information that Mr. Makaroff is now living in Capt.
Kius's house (Commander of S.S."Admiral Zavoiko", 246 Avenue Joffre).
Last Saturday he lost about $1000.00 in gambling in Jewish Club, but
could not pay money. Now he is waiting for the money from Chita.
Dr. Fortoogabeff (626 Rue de la Observatoir) is not Jew but Russian,
he is not Bolshivio, but only sympathiser. He is a member of Social-
Revolutionary Party.

Yours obediently,
W Repas.
D.C. (15).

4581
发自警务处，
工部局，
致 D.I. Sullivan。1922年6月13日。
虹口巡捕房。
上海，1922年5月30日

先生：

我获悉马卡罗夫（Makaroff）先生现居住在基乌斯（Kius）船长家中（“扎沃伊科海军上将”号轮船指挥官，住址为霞飞路246号）。上周六，他在犹太俱乐部赌博输掉约1000美元，但无力支付。目前他正等待来自赤塔的汇款。
福尔图加贝夫博士（Dr. Fortoogabeff）（天文台路626号）并非犹太人，而是俄国人；他并非布尔什维克，仅是同情者。他是社会革命党成员。

此致，
敬礼
W Repas.
巡捕房副主任 (15).

Shanghai Municipal Police.
4581
13/6/22

CENTRAL Station.

May 26 1922

REPORT ON Suspected Prominent Bolshevist

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,

D. C. 15 Repas reports that on or about May 22 he received a typewritten letter written in Russian through the post addressed to him at his house, 103 Dixwell Road. After reading the letter D. C. Repas destroyed it. The writer stated in the letter that he was in the Jewish Club and saw Sailor Lepehin who visited that place under the name Makaroff. It will be very good if the Police arrest that bandit Bolshevik.

D. C. Repas states that he visited the Jewish Club, Seward and Futh Roads corner, on the morning of May 24 and saw Mr. Barro who informed D. C. Repas that a man named Makaroff had visited the club during the previous day or two and that he had been introduced into the club by a Dr. Fortunatoff. Mr. Burro added that Makaroff had been sent by the Chita Government to Shanghai on business in connection with the affairs of the Russian Volunteer Fleet.

D. C. Repas states that a man named Lepehin was Commander-in-chief of the Bolshevik Army in Vladivostock before the Merkuloff Government was formed, and that he afterwards held the same position at Iman. Previous to the revolution he was a sailor in the Russian Navy. Dr. Fortunatoff is said to be very well known amongst the Russian community for his Bolshevistic sympathies.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
D. I.

D. C. I.

4581
1922年6月13日

中央巡捕房。

1922年5月26日

关于涉嫌著名布尔什维克的报告

由 D. I. Sullivan 撰写，经 [签名] 转呈

先生：

巡捕房副主任 (15) Repas 报告称，大约在5月22日，他通过邮政收到一封用俄文打印的信件，寄至其狄思威路103号的住所。Repas 副主任阅信后将其销毁。写信人在信中表示，他在犹太俱乐部见到了以马卡罗夫之名访问该处的水手列佩欣。如果警方能逮捕这名布尔什维克匪徒，那将甚好。

Repas 副主任称，他于5月24日上午走访了位于熙华德路与弗思路拐角处的犹太俱乐部，会见了巴罗（Barro）先生。巴罗先生告知 Repas 副主任，一名名为马卡罗夫的男子在前一两天曾到访该俱乐部，且是由一位福尔图纳托夫博士（Dr. Fortunatoff）引荐入会的。布罗（Burro）先生补充说，马卡罗夫是受赤塔政府派遣来沪，处理与俄国志愿舰队事务有关的事宜。

Repas 副主任称，在梅尔库洛夫（Merkuloff）政府成立之前，一名名为列佩欣的人曾任符拉迪沃斯托克布尔什维克军队总司令，此后在伊曼（Iman）担任相同职务。革命前，他是俄国海军的一名水手。据说福尔图纳托夫博士因其布尔什维克倾向而在俄侨社区中广为人知。

此致，
敬礼
[签名]
D. I.

刑事情报处副主任。

Shanghai Municipal Police.    4581
                              13/6/22

CENTRAL                       Station.

June          10              192 2

REPORT ON   A. Lepehin alias Makaroff

Made by     D. I. Sullivan    Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,

      A Lepehin who was Commander-in-Chief of the
Bolshevist forces in Vladivostock previous to the accession
to power of the Merkuloff Government, and afterwards
held a similar position in Iman, is now in Shanghai where he
goes under the name of Makaroff.

      There are various stories as to the reasons for
Lepehin's visit to Shanghai, one being to the effect that he
has come here to recruit Russian officers for service in
the army of the Far Eastern Republic for which purpose he is
supplied with a large sum of money. Others say that Lepehin
made a fortune whilst in Vladivostock and has come to Shanghai purely
for pleasure.

      Lepehin lives with Dr. Fortunatoff at 626 Rue d'
Observatoire and associates with Commander Klus of the S.S.
"Admiral Zavoika" whose residence at 246 Avenue Joffre he
frequently visits.

      Dr. Fortunatoff is said to have Bolshevist sympa-
thies but is not an active supporter of Bolshevism.

      Lepehin is said to frequent the Jewish Club,
Seward Road and to take part in very heavy gambling there, the
games played being Chemin - de - fer and Baccarat.

                        I am, Sir,

                        Your obedient servant,
                        [Signature]
                        D. I.

D. C. I.

                              1922年6月13日

中央                          巡捕房。

1922年6月10日

关于 A. 列佩欣（化名马卡罗夫）的报告

由         D. I. Sullivan    撰写，经 [签名] 转呈

先生：

      A. 列佩欣曾在梅尔库洛夫政府掌权之前担任符拉迪沃斯托克布尔什维克部队总司令，此后在伊曼担任类似职务，现身处上海，使用马卡罗夫之名。

      关于列佩欣访沪的原因众说纷纭，其中一种说法称，他来此是为了远东共和国军队招募俄国军官，为此他携带了一大笔资金。另一些人则称，列佩欣在符拉迪沃斯托克期间发了财，来上海纯粹是为了享乐。

      列佩欣与福尔图纳托夫博士同住于天文台路626号，并与“扎沃伊卡海军上将”号轮船指挥官克卢斯（Klus）交往密切，他经常前往后者位于霞飞路246号的住所。

      据说福尔图纳托夫博士持有布尔什维克同情立场，但并非布尔什维主义的积极支持者。

      据说列佩欣常去熙华德路的犹太俱乐部，并在那里参与巨额赌博，所玩的游戏为轮盘赌（Chemin-de-fer）和百家乐（Baccarat）。

                        此致，

                        敬礼
                        [签名]
                        D. I.

刑事情报处副主任。

4581
13/4/22

Kopokin and Makaroff is the same
person. All the information re. him and
got formerly (his visiting of the Jewish
Club and gambling there, his connection
with Dr Fortunatoff and Capt Alexeef
Adm. Lavrov) is quite true. He is living
according to the information, at Dr Fortu-
natoff's (626 Rue d'Observatoire).
The aim of his staying here is to offer
Russian officers to enlist the Army
of the F.S.R. He is supplied with
a large sum of money to be able give
salaries in advance to those officers who will agree
to join the Army of the F.S.R and leave
for Chita via Harbin.
pages.zh:
4581
1922年4月13日

科波金（Kopokin）和马卡罗夫是同一个人。所有此前获得的关于他的信息（他造访犹太俱乐部并在那里赌博，他与福尔图纳托夫博士以及阿列克谢耶夫（Alexeef）船长、拉夫罗夫（Lavrov）海军上将的关系）均属实。根据现有信息，他居住在福尔图纳托夫博士处（天文台路626号）。他滞留此地的目的是向俄国军官提供加入远东共和国军队的机会。他备有一大笔资金，以便向那些同意加入远东共和国军队并经哈尔滨前往赤塔的军官预先支付薪水。
